meta.title: Free Chimney Inspection Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: Free chimney inspection at your Toronto or GTA home. Camera photos of the flue, a plain-language explanation, and the price before any work. No obligation.

hero.p: Not sure what shape your chimney is in? We check it top to bottom — inside the flue with a camera — and show you the photos. You find out what needs attention, what can wait and what is fine. Free, with no obligation.
hero.t-2: Camera inside the flue — photos you keep
hero.t-3: What’s urgent, what can wait — and what is fine
hero.t-4: Buying or selling? — know before your conditions date

img.alt: Brick chimney above the roofline during a Northmark inspection

when.h2: When To Book A Chimney Inspection
when.p: Most people call us for one of these reasons.
when.h3: You’re Buying Or Selling A Home
when.p-2: Know what the chimney needs before your conditions date, with photos to back it up.
when.h3-2: It Hasn’t Been Looked At In Years
when.p-3: Or you don’t know when it was. An inspection tells you where it stands.
when.p-4: Smoke in the room, a smell, water near the fireplace, or debris in the firebox.
when.p-5: Freeze-thaw and wind damage the crown, cap and flashing — often out of sight from the ground.
when.p-6: A fireplace that has sat unused deserves a look before it is lit again.
when.p-7: Been told you need a big repair? See the photos and decide for yourself.
when.p-8: Not sure which one you’re seeing? That is what the free inspection is for. Book it here or call {{site.phone}}.

faq.p-2: Yes. The technician comes to your home, looks at the chimney, explains what they see and prices any recommended work on the spot. No obligation — you decide from there.
faq.q-2: What does a chimney inspection include?
faq.p-3: A full visual check — flue, liner, damper, firebox, brick and mortar, crown, cap and flashing — documented with photos and explained on-site in plain language.
faq.q-3: Do I get something in writing?
faq.p-4: Yes — the photos, and a written summary of what needs attention, what can wait, and what is fine as it is.
faq.q-4: Can you inspect a chimney before I buy a home?
faq.p-5: Yes. Tell us your timeline when you book and we’ll do our best to fit the visit before your conditions date. If your lender or insurer asks for a specific type of report, check what they require first, so we can tell you whether ours fits.
faq.q-5: How long does an inspection take?
faq.p-6: It depends on the chimney and access. We give you a realistic window when we confirm the visit, and we don’t rush the look-over.
